propositions: The complexity-baseline lock step runs redundantly inside the OS/Python test matrix (4 cells: Ubuntu 3.11/3.12/3.13 and macOS 3.12), consuming ~206 runner-seconds per Verified change despite being commit-level policy with no platform/version-dependent behavior.

Moving the unchanged lock invocation from jobs.test to the single jobs.lint job preserves fail-closed gate behavior and blocking semantics while eliminating four duplicate executions and their merge-base fetch work.

Workflow unit tests must enforce exactly one complexity-lock invocation in lint and zero in the test matrix, with mutation oracles that fail on current four-cell placement and any future matrix duplication.

Post-merge evidence confirms the lock runs exactly once (5s in lint), is absent from all pytest jobs, and yields 206 runner-seconds saved per Verified run without reducing policy coverage or adding jobs/runners.
